findings.title: H4 consumed/run-progress association under geometry control

observations.statement: Q3/Q4 found a replicated broad positive association between H4 consumed/run-progress state and PATH_REMAINING target-first ordering under the then-frozen research representation.

findings.title: Exness-branded XAUUSDm historical Bid/Ask archive route
findings.current_interpretation: The current frozen Exness-branded XAUUSDm archive coverage contains 134 AVAILABLE months from 2015-08 through 2026-09, and every AVAILABLE month has a latest Validator V0.2 VALIDATED record. This closes the current acquisition/structural-validation coverage task, while tick continuity, duplicate representation, and exact equivalence to the current Exness Demo/MT5 server remain separate residual questions.

observations.statement: The live archive listing exposed XAUUSDm years 2015 through 2026 and the September 2022 monthly ZIP was downloadable from the Owner machine.
observations.representation: Runtime archive listing and downloaded external historical file.

observations.statement: The September 2022 CSV contained 2,377,326 ticks with millisecond UTC Timestamp, Bid and Ask; the full-month scan found zero symbol/source mismatches, Ask < Bid rows, non-finite prices, timestamp regressions, or consecutive exact duplicate rows.

The frozen 2015-2026 coverage snapshot contains 134 AVAILABLE months and the latest Validator V0.2 manifest contains 134 matching validated months with 379,942,589 ticks and 3,430,625,119 ZIP bytes; provider mismatch, symbol mismatch, Ask < Bid, non-finite Bid/Ask and timestamp regression counts are all zero. Equal timestamps, exact duplicate rows, partial-month boundaries and the unresolved 2016 March/April boundary-gap candidate are preserved rather than silently repaired.
observations.representation: Current-coverage acquisition reconciliation using the latest V0.2 record per AVAILABLE month.

observations.statement: In the bounded already-inspected overlap 2026-08-02T22:02:00Z through 23:02:00Z, archive Bid-derived M1 produced 60 bars with 60/60 timestamps matching the saved MT5 M1 export, while 50/60 bars had at least one exact OHLC mismatch. Exact component matches were open 41, high 39, low 32, close 35; no tolerance threshold was inferred.
observations.representation: ARCHIVE_BID_M1_V0.1 versus saved Exness Demo MT5 M1 export; engineering parity only.
conditions: no strategy outcome or holdout scoring

reconciliation.statement: The earlier MT5 authorization and Dukascopy network failures remain true historical observations. The new route supersedes only the earlier conclusion that a locally usable real Bid/Ask historical acquisition path had not yet been closed.
